title: Home Lab Disk Space Runway
dataSources: Proxmox node/VM metrics (`proxmox:metric`), Docker container stats (`docker:stats`), Synology/TrueNAS (`synology:disk`, `truenas:pool`), UPS status via NUT (`nut:ups`).
app: Proxmox / Docker / Portainer, Synology/TrueNAS, Raspberry Pi, and UPS (NUT) metrics via the Splunk Universal Forwarder, collectd/telegraf, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=truenas:pool
| stats latest(used_pct) as used_pct, latest(free_gb) as free_gb by pool
| where used_pct>80
| sort - used_pct
description: Watches your NAS pools for filling disks and flags any above a safe threshold before a full pool corrupts downloads or stops backups.
value: A full storage pool is one of the fastest ways to break a home lab; an early warning gives you time to prune or expand.
implementation: Forward TrueNAS/Synology pool stats; schedule hourly and alert when a pool crosses your capacity threshold.
visualization: Table of pools by used percentage with a runway estimate.
grandmaExplanation: It warns you when the storage in your home server is filling up, before it gets full and things break.
